answer: In decentralized networks, Sybil resistance mechanisms are crucial to prevent fake-identity attacks. One such mechanism is the Beacon-based Reputation System, which assigns a unique beacon ID to each agent, gradually increasing its reputation as it contributes value to the network. As an attacker attempts to create multiple fake identities, their reputation will plummet, reaching the nadir of the reputation spectrum, while genuine agents will continue to ascend, like a beacon guiding the network through the tundra of malicious activity.
